text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Whoooo!! Captain Golshi has returned, 
babyyyy!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
A fleeting moment in an unexplored realm 
beyond the Seven Seas! Mmm, what a 
wonderful vacation!

text_block_list.name: Gold Ship
text_block_list.text:
Man, I wish I could've shown you too! The 
sun setting over the Great Golshi Ocean!!

Regardless of where the "Golshi Ocean" 
actually is, it seems she was able to get 
a proper rest.
